grain_resource_building_1 = {

	construction_time = construction_time_6_months
	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		county = { has_potential_for_trade_good = trade_good_type:trade_good_grain }
	
            }
        }
    }
	is_enabled = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	show_disabled = yes
	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	cost_gold = resource_district_normal_tier_1_cost
	province_modifier = {
		building_slots_for_host_district = 1
		trade_good_grain_production_add = grain_tier_1_main_resource
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		not_parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_agricultural_tax = grain_tier_1_main_income
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_agricultural_tax = grain_tier_1_main_income_tribal
	}
	province_terrain_modifier = {
		parameter = mountaineer_ruralism_mountain_production
		terrain = mountains
		trade_good_grain_production_mult = 0.25
	}
	market_modifier = {
		trade_good_iron_sell_price_mult = price_metal_building_1
		trade_good_cattle_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
	}

	province_culture_modifier = {
		parameter = industrious_productivity_bonus
		trade_good_grain_production_mult = 0.1
		monthly_agricultural_tax = industrious_tradition_tax_bonus_low
	}

	trade_good_need = { #First Need Fulfillment
		trade_good = trade_good_iron #Heavy Plows
		amount = metal_resource_need
		culture_parameter = heavy_plow
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_grain_production_mult = grain_multiplier_per_iron_need
				agricultural_tax_mult = tax_mult_per_production_need
			}
		}
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_cattle #Oxen - Pulling the Plows
		amount = low_resource_district_need
		not_culture_parameter = heavy_plow
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_grain_production_mult = grain_multiplier_per_beast_need
				agricultural_tax_mult = tax_mult_per_production_need
			}
		}
	}

	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good_category = trade_category_beasts_of_burden #Oxen or Horses, once we have the Heavy Plow
		amount = low_resource_district_need
		culture_parameter = heavy_plow
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_grain_production_mult = grain_multiplier_per_beast_need
				agricultural_tax_mult = tax_mult_per_production_need
			}
		}
	}
	#No needs on first level
	on_complete = {
	}
	flag = agricultural_district_building
	flag = food_district_building
	next_building = grain_resource_building_2
	type_icon = "district_buildings/grain_district.dds"
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_need_category_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_grain CATEGORY = trade_category_cereals }
		ai_resource_building_consumer_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_iron }

	construction_time = construction_time_6_months
	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		NOT = { rite = { rite_has_parameter = alcohol_forbidden_strict } }
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	show_disabled = yes
	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	cost_gold = resource_district_normal_tier_1_cost
	province_government_modifier = {
		not_parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_artisan_tax = brewery_income_tier_1
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_artisan_tax = brewery_income_tier_1_tribal
	}
	province_culture_modifier = {
		parameter = brewery_popular_opinion
		popular_opinion_add = 1
	}
	province_rite_modifier = {
		parameter = ritual_brewing_popular_opinion
		popular_opinion_add = 1
	}
	market_modifier = {
		trade_good_grain_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_grain
		amount = basic_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_beer_production_add = brewery_output_per_level
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				not_parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = monthly_tax_per_beer_level
			}
			province_government_modifier = {
				parameter = government_is_tribal
				monthly_artisan_tax = monthly_tax_per_beer_level_tribal
			}
		}
	}
	on_complete = {
	}
	next_building = beer_brewery_2
	type_icon = "resource_buildings/breweries.dds"
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_need_category_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_beer CATEGORY = trade_category_alcohol }
		ai_resource_building_consumer_category_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_grain CATEGORY = trade_category_cereals }
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_income_building_modifier = yes
		ai_market_category_shortage_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_beer CATEGORY = trade_category_alcohol }
		ai_resource_new_building_modifier = yes
	}

	construction_time = construction_time_6_months
	triggered_name = {
		trigger = {
			building_requirement_winter_region = yes
		}
		reference = "winter_stores_1"
	}
	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_non_tribal = yes
	
            }
        }
    }
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	show_disabled = yes
	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
	
            }
        }
    }
	cost_gold = resource_district_normal_tier_1_cost
	province_government_modifier = {
		not_parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_agricultural_tax = grain_stores_income_tier_1
	}
	province_government_modifier = {
		parameter = government_is_tribal
		monthly_agricultural_tax = grain_stores_income_tier_1_tribal
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_grain
		amount = basic_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				monthly_control_change_when_below_baseline_add = grain_stores_control_per_grain_need
			}
		}
	}
	on_complete = {
	}
	next_building = grain_stores_2
	type_icon = "resource_buildings/fodder_stores.dds"
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_resource_building_consumer_category_modifier = { GOOD = trade_good_grain CATEGORY = trade_category_cereals }
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_income_building_modifier = yes

	}
